title: Unit Event — At The End of The Unraveled Thread — Episode6 The Great Idol War!

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread
meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! is all set for their first TV appearance. However, the show's MC just happens to be the leader of the very group Shizuku used to be in, Cheerful * Days. As excited as she was about making their shoot a success, this surprise reunion has Shizuku...

rows.Line: The day of the shoot
TV Station - Studio

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Alright, it's time for...!
idol...

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Hazard!!!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: This week's MCs will be the lead of Cheerful * Days, myself, Arisa Higure, and—!

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: Marina Yamashita, one of the new additions from the fourth generation!
se_event_thread_2023_005

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I-I-I-It's finally starting...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're not supposed to appear for a while, so let's relax and just watch as spectators until then.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-How are you able to stay so calm, Haruka...?! It feels like my heart's about to burst out of my chest...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Says the girl who was chowing down on snacks in the green room until just a second ago. You're not gonna last very long at this rate.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Minori.
Just try to remember what we discussed during our meeting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll feel much better once you do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right!
Just focus on myself...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I want to get my name out there...
So I can spread hope to as many people as I can...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now it sounds like she's chanting something...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I think it's working.

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: And I've been hooked on this stuff called “drinkable cake” lately because having actual cake late at night is like the opposite of eating healthy, you know?!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean.
But doesn't that mean you're still taking in the same amount of calories?

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
That's the thing!
They use really low-fat cream, which means I can have as much as I like!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: “As much as you like” doesn't mean less calories!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Still, Marina, you really do love sweets, don't you?
It's almost your birthday, so why don't you make a little request to your fans out there?

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
Wait, you mean it?!
Then, I'll take this opportunity to tell them that... I want lots and lots of snacks and treats♪
se_event_thread_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Arisa's improved quite a bit as an MC...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She must be working very hard considering how many different programs she's been appearing on lately.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Not only that, but everyone on the big panel...)

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
Slow down, Marina!
Don't forget that we're not really allowed to ask people to give us food!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Also, what happened to the fourth generation being the new kids on the block? You seem pretty used to being in the spotlight, Marina! Are you sure you're really a rookie?
se_event_thread_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They know how to throw in funny quips and jabs at the right moments. They're working very well together to the show's benefit. Which reinforces how...)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Alright, settle down. That's the sort of banter iHaz needs, but no more ganging up on the new girl. So, for our next segment...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I really shouldn't have been the lead of Cheerful * Days back then...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I was supposed to just do as I was told, but I really only followed the scripts they gave me... I had no ability to actually speak for myself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Even that didn't go well on a number of occasions, and the others were forced to save me.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (My mind was so overwhelmed by having to play the “perfect” Shizuku Hinomori...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm not that girl anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You were given a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that the rest of us would do anything for, but you don't seem to care whatsoever about capitalizing on it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That time, I didn't fully comprehend what she meant...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But now, I...)

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
MORE MORE JUMP!
You're on standby!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ready, everyone...?!
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I'm ready whenever.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I-I-I-I'm ready...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how you do in front of the cameras, Minori, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
How about you, Shizuku?
It's been a while since you've been on TV.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's been a long time since I last did this, but let's try to make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Then, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Next, we have the mini segment that's all the rage right now! It's another edition of “Feature the Future” brought to you today by Marina and Arisa!

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
So, let's bring in our guests!
Give a big round of applause for MORE MORE JUMP!
se_event_thread_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Uh... The script said... Oh, we start by introducing ourselves...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't give up on your dreams, Minorinrin! Here's a bouquet of hope for you! Hello! I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No matter how far, may this song of hope reach you! I'm Haruka Kiritani from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One special delivery of love coming right up!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's the lovely fairy, Airi! Airi Momoi from MORE MORE JUMP! at your service!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Here to bring you a burst of happiness. I'm Shizuku Hinomori from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is our first time appearing on TV together, so...

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for having us!
se_event_thread_2023_005

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
Wow! MORE MORE JUMP! in the flesh!
Welcome to idol Hazard!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: We've been looking forward to having you on!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Actually, mind if we talk like normal for this? I mean, I feel pretty awkward speaking so formally...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Again, there's no need to act so formal here. After all, we're members of the same group. Also...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: You guys sound like you all go to the same high school or something. You've met some of them before, right, Arisa?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Yeah, I've worked with Airi before when she was still with QT. Them and Cheerful * Days are managed by the same agency.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, that takes me back...
Remember when both our groups did that big sports day event together?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: However, Haruka, Minori, we may or may not have crossed paths before, but this is essentially our first time talking to one another.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, it is...
We've been looking forward to seeing you today.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Likewise!
And there's no need for either of you to be formal with me. That just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I believe our viewers are more than aware that Shizuku and I have some history.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: Yeah, Shizuku, you used to be in Cheerful * Days, right?! You moved on before I joined, so this is my first time seeing you in person!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
No, she didn't “move on”.
She left us behind!
se_event_thread_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa! Really?! Now?!
Our segment literally just started!
se_event_thread_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Honestly.
We haven't even had a chance to sit down yet.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry! My bad!
I got a little ahead of myself since we have so much to discuss.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Anyway, please, take your seats!
There are several questions that I want to ask since we don't see each other often.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I have to think our viewers are beyond excited about Cheerful * Days and MORE MORE JUMP! appearing together today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
I've been looking forward to speaking with you and the others today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I had a feeling that it was going to get a bit heated today, but she seems eager to go right at us.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Shizuku leaving wasn't a good thing for them either. The agency must've seen the script for this, so a part of me hoped that they'd keep their idols from going too far.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I definitely underestimated this girl. Also...)

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: iHaz has earned its reputation for featuring raw and uncut conversations between idols. Surprise stories are always welcome, so...

rows.Speaker: iHaz Producer
rows.Line: So we're actually looking forward to seeing how you and the MCs interact.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Yeah, that's television for you...
We came knowing that something like this could happen.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Is Shizuku really gonna be okay...?)
